annotations.title: Screen a wallet address against the OFAC sanctioned-address list

description:
Checks a crypto wallet address (EVM, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, Litecoin) against OFAC's listed digital-currency addresses. Exact match on the official list only; not behavioural or cluster risk.
Use when about to pay or send funds to an address, vetting a counterparty wallet, or checking a deposit address.
Inputs: address; optional chain (evm, bitcoin, tron, solana, litecoin, other).
Returns: sanctioned, riskLevel (CLEAR/EXACT_MATCH/UNKNOWN), addressType, matches[], coverage.
Source: OFAC SDN, refreshed every 6h. Same input → same output. $0.002 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

address.description: Wallet address to screen (EVM 0x..., Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, Litecoin or other base58 form)

chain.description: Optional chain hint: evm | bitcoin | tron | solana | litecoin | other. Rejected if it contradicts the address format.

name: screen_address
